images.prompt: Small square smoke test: one crisp pixel-art Stone Age campfire with a stone ring, light from upper left, isolated on solid flat magenta #FF00FF background. No text, no letters, no logo. Opaque background. 1024 by 1024.

Top-down orthographic pixel-art screenshot of a Stone Age village simulation game. The ground is seen from directly above; people and objects are drawn in a slight three-quarter front view standing on their tiles. The world is a grid of 16-pixel tiles shown at 4× zoom, so every art pixel is a crisp square block with no anti-aliasing and no blur. A small camp on the east bank of a narrow river that runs from top to bottom: one central campfire with a ring of stones, three lean-to shelters made of branches and hides, one storage pit with baskets of food, one half-built shelter frame, several berry bushes with red berries at the forest edge, grassland with small tufts, patches of forest, one rocky outcrop. About twenty small villagers in simple hide clothing doing different things: carrying food, drinking at the river bank, sitting by the fire, building the frame. Midday light from the upper left with short soft shadows to the lower right. No user interface, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
